principle: detect first, correct second, never force by default

layers.owner: nxcompat, nxgl, nxinput, nxloader and nxandroid
responsibilities: guest ELF loading through explicit imports
validation of adapter-declared Android lifecycle and import contracts
forbidden: generic fake JNI, lifecycle callbacks or teardown

responsibilities: save, cache, UI and clean shutdown
forbidden: promoting a local workaround to a framework default

components.compatibility: the generator emits exactly one small visible PortMaster launcher (Limbo shape: control.txt chain, get_controls, GAMEDIR from $directory, log.txt, pm_platform_helper, foreground game, pm_finish) plus nxport.json; run.sh is forbidden in generated ports; the nxbootstrap-*.sh runtime library and nxdeployment.json receipt are retired from generated output; port-specific runtime selection lives in an optional non-symlink port-env.sh sourced by the launcher
API 2 preserves API 1 numeric values and leading fields; current structs require matching api_version and struct_size, and legacy backend discovery cannot exceed the API 2 two-attempt ceiling
API 2 is additive while NXGL_API_VERSION and all API 1 layouts and entry points remain literal; current integrations use NXGL_API_CURRENT_VERSION and freeze one stack owner through close
public structs require matching api_version and struct_size
API 1.3 preserves earlier values; registry and loader structs require matching api_version and struct_size
profiles and operations require matching api_version and struct_size; engine objects and callbacks remain adapter-owned
release manifest schema 2 is required; older release manifests fail closed
core, runner, runtime env and recipe are an exact content-pinned set

nxport.legacy_policy: the generator accepts v1 only as input and materializes every v2 default; release consumes the canonical v2 output

home_policy.port: sets HOME to the contained port directory only after explicit opt-in
home_policy.save_and_cache: remain engine-native unless the adapter has a separately proven contained mapping; the generic manifest never redirects them by firmware name

nxport.argument_policy: arrays are passed through shell positional parameters without eval or string concatenation
nxport.prepare_policy: one optional regular non-symlink script contained by the port and executed in foreground
nxport.private_library_policy: only declared contained paths enter the game phase; firmware and PortMaster paths remain separate

generator.1: invalid manifest, template or filesystem operation

runtime.1: bootstrap/setup failure unless a more specific child status applies
runtime.129: HUP received and exact-child cleanup completed
runtime.130: INT received and exact-child cleanup completed
runtime.143: TERM received and exact-child cleanup completed
runtime.child: all other direct-child exit statuses are preserved

exit_codes.message_policy: diagnosis has four ordered boundaries: missing nxdeployment.json means the observed tree lacks the deployment; a receipt with no new launcher-error or debug.log means there is no durable proof that the early trap was reached, so PortMaster entry/root, interpreter/parse, writable storage, SIGKILL and power loss must be checked without claiming non-invocation; launcher-error means pre-runtime failure after the trap; debug.log phase markers mean nxbootstrap runtime; no script can log before it is executed; secrets, IP addresses and personal paths are excluded from public UI
